steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Expressive skills enable a dancer to communicate meaning, mood and intention to the audience | Key Fact: Projection is the ability to reach out to the audience with energy and presence, making the performance compelling to watch | Key Fact: Focus is the direction of the dancer's gaze and attention, guiding the audience's eye and expressing intention | Key Fact: Musicality is the dancer's response to the music, showing awareness of rhythm, tempo, accents and phrasing through movement

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from expressive skills in dance, and one past-paper question.
